name: All cloud-hosted compute instances and corporate devices MUST run an approved EDR tool with 24/7 monitoring and alerting to the central SoC to ensure detection and stop hackers who bypass initial defences.
conditionsText: Applies to all company devices and any cloud servers
requirementTitle: All cloud-hosted compute instances and corporate devices MUST run an approved EDR tool with 24/7 monitoring and alerting to the central SoC to ensure detection and stop hackers who bypass initial defences.
requirementDescription: Every cloud server and company-managed device must have an approved Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR) security tool installed, and that tool must be continuously monitored by the Security Operations Centre (SOC) so that attacks can be detected and stopped quickly.
why: Organisations assume that, despite firewalls, secure passwords, email filtering, and other protections, an attacker may still manage to get onto a device or server. EDR is there to detect and respond when that happens.
tasks: All cloud-hosted compute instances and corporate devices MUST run an approved EDR tool with 24/7 monitoring and alerting to the central SoC

actions.title: All cloud-hosted compute instances and corporate devices MUST run an approved EDR tool with 24/7 monitoring and alerting to the central SoC
actions.description: All company devices and cloud servers must have approved security monitoring software installed and connected to the security operations team so cyber attacks can be detected and stopped as quickly as possible.
